subject: Park Permits and Public Art Installation
overview: The Parks Commission approved several seasonal field permits for youth soccer, kickball, and club training, and authorized moving a public art installation to Brooks Park. A proposed contract with the USTA regarding smart court access was tabled pending legal review by the City Solicitor.

items.title: Kickball Tournament Permit
items.summary: The commission approved a permit for a kickball event on October 12th using all four fields for a $25 fee after coordinating schedules with the girls' softball league.

items.title: Medford Youth Soccer Fall Permits
items.summary: Approved fall field usage for Medford Youth Soccer across several city parks from August 25th through November 15th.

items.title: FC Stars Soccer Training Permit
items.summary: Approved a permit for FC Stars soccer training at Morrison Field for a $1,000 seasonal fee, contingent on the organization providing necessary insurance documentation.

items.title: MYGS Spooky Scrimmage Coordination
items.summary: Coordinated field time for an upcoming "spooky scrimmage" trick-or-treating event held under the lights at Columbus Park.

items.title: Brooks Park Art Installation
items.summary: Approved the relocation of a traveling art exhibit to Brooks Park near the slave wall for approximately two weeks, despite concerns regarding parking and residential impact.

items.title: USTA Smart Access Contract
items.summary: The commission tabled the USTA contract and smart access project until the City Solicitor resolves legal concerns and a response is received from USTA legal teams.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from July.
